source.source_authority: Official public OSCaR human-verified EPIC benchmark split
source.license_note: The Hugging Face release is marked other and contains EPIC-KITCHENS-derived assets; this research use inherits source terms.

cohort.selection: Filter only by the public action_narration regex, then take the 64 clip IDs with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of SC42_OSCAR_GLEA_V1 NUL clip_id.
cohort.candidate_selection: Use the three image_path rows whose basename is not state_change.jpg.
cohort.candidate_order: Sort by SHA-256 of SC42_OPTION_V1 NUL clip_id NUL image_path; expose labels A, B, C only.

model.candidate_semantics: Frozen zero-shot CLIP global and 7x7 patch embeddings; no OSCaR training or outcome calibration

frozen_algorithm.name: Goal-Localized Effect Axis v1

turn_on.before: a photo of the {object} switched off and inactive
turn_on.after: a photo of the {object} switched on and active

turn_off.before: a photo of the {object} switched on and active
turn_off.after: a photo of the {object} switched off and inactive

frozen_algorithm.action_mapping: open->open, close->close, turn/switch on->turn_on, turn/switch off->turn_off; fail closed otherwise
frozen_algorithm.baseline: Choose the candidate with maximum global cosine similarity to the scripted after-state prompt.
frozen_algorithm.effect_axis: L2-normalize(after-state text embedding minus before-state text embedding).
frozen_algorithm.localization: For each candidate independently, select the five CLIP patch embeddings with highest cosine similarity to the entity prompt.
frozen_algorithm.successor: Choose the candidate with maximum mean projection of its five entity-selected patches onto the effect axis; use global effect-axis projection and then lexicographically smallest option label only as ties.
frozen_algorithm.tie_break: localized effect, then global effect, then A before B before C
frozen_algorithm.abstention: UNKNOWN when the action script, three-image roster, media, exact model identity, or actual device/provider is invalid.
frozen_algorithm.truth_firewall: Only public goal/object text and three content images may reach inference. Caption keys, captions, temporal order, and Frame_3 identity are forbidden until the provider is written and SHA-256 sealed.

forbidden_after_outcome: change source filter, cohort, model, prompts, templates, patch count, pooling, tie break, or gate
train, calibrate, rescale, or tune on the opened 64 clips
remove dark, blurred, delayed-effect, difficult, or failed clips
claim general arrival, online search, metric approach, reachability, executed user action, handoff, product benefit, or safety
claim_boundary: One fresh public real-egocentric three-frame mechanism test on a curated open/close/on/off action subset. It tests whether an entity-localized language effect direction identifies the most completed observation better than static desired-state similarity. Frame candidates and action/object text are benchmark-provided. It does not establish online target discovery, exact-instance grounding, spatial guidance, physical approach, reachability, user action, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
